title: Boolean coordinate projection
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube and a set of coordinates $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, its coordinate projection onto $J$ is the real-valued function obtained by projecting the real-valued version of $f$ onto those coordinates with respect to the uniform probability measure on the sign set.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
caveat: The upstream definition of the coordinate projection and the real-valued interpretation of the sign-valued function are not included, so their precise mathematical meaning cannot be determined from this snippet alone.
